Name: Modest Maps Ginger Island Farm
Author: InkubusMods
Description:
[b][size=3]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6![/size][/b]

[u]REQUIRES:[/u]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Yep. That's it.
[/list]
Modest Maps Ginger Farm is a vanilla Ginger Island West redesigned for ample space, without sacrificing the aesthetic of it.
All Golden Walnuts should still be accessible!

[u]FEATURES:[/u]
Clean farm sized for plenty of sprinklers.
An additional small field to till.
A cleaner beach for more mussel nodes.

[u]INSTALLATION:

[/u]Manual:
1. Download the file.
2. Extract the Folder.
3. Put said folder into:
﻿Steam>Steamapps>Common>StardewValley>Mods.
4. Load with SMAPI.
5. Enjoy.

Supports Vortex Download and installation!

[u]SIDE NOTES:[/u]
If you like my work or have found an issue, I'd love for you to let me know in the POSTS!
